import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int R, C, N;
    static char[] S;
    static long[][] Cnk;
    static int[] prefA, prefB;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] vecA, vecB;

    static void gen_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            Cnk[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
                Cnk[i][j] = Cnk[i-1][j-1] + Cnk[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    static long diff(int mask, int a0, int b0) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; i++) {
            if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b0++;
                long t1 = Cnk[b0 - 1][R - 1];
                long t2 = Cnk[N - b0][R] - Cnk[a0][R];
                res -= t1 * t2;
            } else {
                a0++;
                long t1 = Cnk[a0 - 1][R - 1];
                long t2 = Cnk[N - a0][R] - Cnk[b0][R];
                res += t1 * t2;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean ok(int mask) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; i++) {
            if (S[2 * R + C + i] == 'A' && ((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) return false;
            if (S[2 * R + C + i] == 'B' && ((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void build_second() {
        int limit = 1 << (C + 1);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < limit; mask++) {
            int bcnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            int acnt = C + 1 - bcnt;
            long val = diff(mask, R + C - acnt, R + C - bcnt);
            if (ok(mask))
                vecA[acnt].add(val);
            else
                vecB[acnt].add(val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= C + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vecA[i]);
            Collections.sort(vecB[i]);
        }
    }

    static long coef(int mask) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < C + 1; i++)
            if (((mask >> i) & 1) != (mask & 1))
                break;
        for (j = i; j < C + 1; j++) {
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((mask >> j) & 1) != 0) return 0;
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'B' && ((mask >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }
        int setA = R - 1 + ((mask & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int setB = R - 1 + ((mask & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        if (setA < prefA[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (setB < prefB[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return Cnk[setA + setB - prefA[2 * R - 2 + i] - prefB[2 * R - 2 + i]][setA - prefA[2 * R - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(long[] best, long[] cur) {
        if (cur[0] < 0) cur[0] = -cur[0];
        if (best[0] < cur[0]) return;
        if (best[0] > cur[0]) {
            best[0] = cur[0];
            best[1] = cur[1];
            return;
        }
        best[1] += cur[1];
    }

    static long cnt_val(ArrayList<Long> v, long x) {
        int lo = Collections.binarySearch(v, x);
        if (lo < 0) lo = -lo - 1;
        int hi = Collections.binarySearch(v, x + 1);
        if (hi < 0) hi = -hi - 1;
        return hi - lo;
    }

    static long first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (C + 1);
        long[] ans = new long[]{1L << 60, 0};
        for (int mask = 0; mask < limit; mask++) {
            int bcnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            int acnt = C + 1 - bcnt;
            long cur = diff(mask, R - 1, R - 1);
            long cf = coef(mask);
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(vecA[C + 1 - acnt], -cur);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            if (idx < vecA[C + 1 - acnt].size()) {
                long val = vecA[C + 1 - acnt].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = cnt_val(vecA[C + 1 - acnt], val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + cur, cf * cnt});
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                long val = vecA[C + 1 - acnt].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = cnt_val(vecA[C + 1 - acnt], val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + cur, cf * cnt});
                }
            }
            cf = 0;
            idx = Collections.binarySearch(vecB[C + 1 - acnt], -cur);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            if (idx < vecB[C + 1 - acnt].size()) {
                long val = vecB[C + 1 - acnt].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = cnt_val(vecA[C + 1 - acnt], val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + cur, cf * cnt});
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                long val = vecB[C + 1 - acnt].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = cnt_val(vecA[C + 1 - acnt], val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + cur, cf * cnt});
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        S = new char[2 * (R + C) + 5];
        String s = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= s.length(); i++) {
            S[i] = s.charAt(i - 1);
        }
        N = 2 * (R + C);
        Cnk = new long[MAX][MAX];
        gen_comb();
        prefA = new int[N + 5];
        prefB = new int[N + 5];
        for (int pos = 1; pos <= N; pos++) {
            prefA[pos] = prefA[pos-1] + (S[pos] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            prefB[pos] = prefB[pos-1] + (S[pos] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        vecA = new ArrayList[C + 2];
        vecB = new ArrayList[C + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= C + 1; i++) {
            vecA[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            vecB[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        build_second();
        long sol = first_part();
        System.out.println(sol);
    }

    static final int MAX = 66;
}
